tutorial.trickDisplay: This is the current trick. Follow the led suit if you can; otherwise play a trump; otherwise play any card. The highest trump wins the trick.
tutorial.playerHand: This is your hand. Click a card to select it. Scarto is a 3-player trick-taker on the 78-card tarot deck (four 14-card suits, 21 numbered trumps, and the Excuse).
tutorial.playButton: Once a card is selected, play it with this button. When you are the dealer, bury three low cards in the scarto phase.
tutorial.info: Scarto is a 3-player Piedmontese tarocchi trick-taker. There is no bidding, chien, or partnership. The dealer buries three surplus cards (the scarto), then the three players play out the tricks. Each deal is scored as a zero-sum settlement against the average of the players' captured card-points; the highest cumulative score after the set deals wins.
tutorial.resetButton: Use the reset button to start a new game.
